methods.name: extract_macrotrends
methods.description: Parse the uploaded PDF ("251118_2026 trends macrotrends es") and return a structured list of all numbered macrotrend headings together with the paragraph that immediately follows each heading.
steps: Locate every line that matches the pattern “<number> | ” to detect a macro-trend heading.
Capture the heading text itself (e.g. “1 | El auge de la personalización adaptativa y la relevancia contextual” ).
Collect all subsequent lines until the next heading is encountered; join them as that trend’s summary (e.g. paragraph beginning “En los mercados globales…” ).
Emit a JSON array where each item has keys: id (numeric order), title (heading minus the numeric prefix), and summary (captured paragraph).
